'''John Nathan Henderson''' (born January 9, 1979), nicknamed "'''Big John'''" or "'''Big Hen'''", is an American former professional [[American football|football]] player who was a [[defensive tackle]] for ten seasons in the [[National Football League]] (NFL). He played [[college football]] for the [[Tennessee Volunteers football|Tennessee Volunteers]] and was a two-time consensus [[College Football All-America Team|All-American]]. The [[Jacksonville Jaguars]] chose him in the first round of the [[2002 NFL draft]], and he was selected for the [[Pro Bowl]] twice. He also played for the [[Oakland Raiders]]. Henderson was inducted into the [[College Football Hall of Fame]] in 2025.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://footballfoundation.org/news/2025/1/15/nff-announces-all-star-2025-college-football-hall-of-fame-class.aspx | title=NFF Announces All-Star 2025 College Football Hall of Fame Class | publisher=[[National Football Foundation]] | date=January 15, 2025 | accessdate=16 January 2025}}</ref>

'''John Allen Hannah''' (born April 4, 1951), is an American former [[American football|football]] [[Guard (gridiron football)|guard]] who played in the [[National Football League]] (NFL) for 13 seasons with the [[New England Patriots]]. Nicknamed "'''Hog'''", he is considered one of the greatest offensive linemen of all time.<ref>{{Cite magazine|url=https://www.si.com/vault/issue/70950/1/1|title=SI Vault – Aug. 3, 1981 – Page 1|magazine=Sports Illustrated|access-date=June 26, 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=NFL 100: At No. 25, John Hannah was maybe NFL's best offensive lineman ever — 'He had no weaknesses' |publisher=The Athletic |work=Steve Buckley |date=2021-08-15 |url=https://theathletic.com/2733793/2021/08/15/nfl-100-at-no-25-john-hannah-was-maybe-nfls-best-offensive-lineman-ever-he-had-no-weaknesses/?amp=1 |access-date=2023-02-16}}</ref>

Hannah played [[college football]] for the [[Alabama Crimson Tide football|Alabama Crimson Tide]], winning the [[Jacobs Blocking Trophy]] in 1972. He was selected fourth overall in the [[1973 NFL draft]] by the Patriots, where he received nine [[Pro Bowl]] and seven first-team [[All-Pro]] selections. Hannah was inducted to the [[Pro Football Hall of Fame]] in 1991 and the [[College Football Hall of Fame]] in 1999. The same year as the former, he became the inaugural inductee of the [[New England Patriots Hall of Fame]].

'''John Louis Hardy Jr.''' (born June 11, 1968) is an American former professional [[Gridiron football|football]] player who was a [[defensive back]] for one season with the [[Chicago Bears]] of the [[National Football League]] (NFL). He played [[college football]] for the [[California Golden Bears football|California Golden Bears]]. He also played for the [[Ottawa Rough Riders]] and [[Toronto Argonauts]] of the [[Canadian Football League]] (CFL).
